ModMetaData.name: Alpha Animals Retextured
ModMetaData.author: KScav
ModMetaData.description:
A simple retexture of some Alpha Animals. I remade a very old retexture of a gallatross that I created a long time ago and added more retextures.
✦ Be sure to load this after Alpha Animals. ✦ If you don't like some of the textures, you can simply delete them in the mod folder. ✦ All textures are 512x512. ✦ Desiccated textures were unchanged. ✦ Graphics Settings+ is strongly recommended.
I may add more retextures in the future.
